title: STF.------MTH.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 490 (MP(II)-8). STF (source transfer) is the subject; MTH (methodology) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-DY (information dynamics), ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) and WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). From INFO-DY: ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism). From ALT-FT: TRS (transition) and SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics). From WO-EXP-PRI: RE-ST (restructuralism). From ACC-FT: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From SCI-DYM: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment). From RE-ST: PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental) and RIT-DY (ritual dynamics).
